$comment: The care topics the /services/ page lists, and the Service nodes the practice publishes in its JSON-LD (scripts/post_build_aeo_geo.js). Each service carries its own words: `summary` says what the care covers and `ask` is one question a patient can bring to the exam. The build stops if a service has no summary or ask, or if two services share one (Search Readiness q1, 25 Nov 2026: one sentence repeated on every card read as template filler). No prices: the practice publishes none, so every Offer is price-on-request and points at /book/, where the booking page handles pricing. Never add a price here, and never a promise of a result.

services.name: Preventive care
services.summary: Routine exams and professional cleanings, with time to discuss brushing, flossing and when to schedule your next visit.
services.ask: How often should I schedule cleanings given my dental history?

services.name: Restorative care
services.summary: Fillings and crowns are examples of repairs a dentist may discuss for a tooth affected by decay, a crack or wear.
services.ask: How will you decide whether this tooth needs a filling or a crown?

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.summary: A conversation about the tooth color, shape or spacing you would like to change and the options available after an exam.
services.ask: Which options fit the changes I want to make to my smile?

services.name: Emergency dental care
services.summary: Tooth pain, a broken tooth or a dental injury are reasons to contact the office about an urgent visit.
services.ask: What details should I share when I call about a broken tooth?

services.name: Dentures and implants
services.summary: Dentures and implants are options a dentist can discuss when one or more teeth are missing. The discussion includes how each option is fitted and cared for.
services.ask: What would daily care look like with each option?

services.name: Teeth whitening
services.summary: Whitening is a conversation about the shade of your natural teeth and how it may look alongside existing fillings, veneers or crowns.
services.ask: How might whitening affect the way my crowns or fillings match?
